suggestions.title: Buy or license an archived NFL odds history (opening + closing prices)
suggestions.context: The price snapshot store (opener/closer per market) is an empty shell: the NFL publishes no odds, so every market_line is blank and Gate G7 can never pass. Without a price history nothing can be backtested as a bet, no ROI is computable, and no reward can be paid as anything but research points.
options: Buy a licensed archived odds feed (e.g. the NFL's official sports-data distributors) and record opener + closer per market
Continue with assumed -110 only, clearly labelled as a forecast, not a bet
Do not operate a betting function at all; keep this as pure research
suggestions.evidence: nfl.com/standings and nfl.com/games carry no odds values; price_snapshot_store is blank for opener/closer on every market.
suggestions.cost: High (licence fee) if a real feed; nil if research-only.
suggestions.risk: High: operating without a settled legal position (S02) could expose the project; paying for a feed before the legal question is settled is wasted spend.
suggestions.recommendation: Settle S02 first, then decide S01. Until a real price exists, keep every line labelled 'forecast, not a price'.

suggestions.title: Establish the operating jurisdiction and whether derived lines may be published
suggestions.context: No jurisdiction, licence status, or permission to publish derived probabilities has been established. Rewards are research points only because no funding or legal basis exists to pay anything else.
options: Engage counsel to confirm jurisdiction and publishing rights before any line is published as actionable
Publish only as analytical research with a prominent not-wagering-advice disclaimer (current state)
suggestions.evidence: Responsible-gambling help cited site-wide (ncpgambling.org/help-treatment); no licence or jurisdiction on record.
suggestions.risk: High: publishing derived lines as if actionable without a legal position is the project's largest exposure.
suggestions.recommendation: Decide now: engage counsel before describing anything as a bet or paying rewards beyond research points.

suggestions.title: Obtain an official depth chart / snap-count feed so replacement depth can be tracked
suggestions.context: The brief asks for defensive/offensive deficiencies tracked as 2nd/3rd/4th-string backups replacing starters. The NFL publishes no depth chart (nfl.com/depth-charts/ is a 404) and no official snap-count feed. A string label produced today would be invented, so none is published.
options: Wait for the NFL to publish a depth chart
Use a third-party depth chart and label it third-party
Track only official game-status designations (current state)
suggestions.evidence: nfl.com/depth-charts/ returns 404 (re-checked 2026-11-14); injury report gives game status only, not starter or snap count.
suggestions.cost: Nil if waiting; moderate if licensing third-party depth data.
suggestions.risk: Medium: labelling a player '3rd string' without an official source is invention.
suggestions.recommendation: Blocked until an official or clearly-labelled third-party depth source exists. Publish only game-status designations and lineup changes named in official reporting.

suggestions.title: Begin a weekly injury snapshot archive
suggestions.context: nfl.com/injuries/ serves the current week only, so no historical injury archive exists and no injury effect can be back-tested. A weekly snapshot (this project's own store) would build the archive over time.
options: Start a weekly snapshot store of the official injury report
Remain current-week only
Buy a historical injury archive if one exists
suggestions.evidence: injuries_week10 capture is partial (3 of 8 nfl.com chunks); nfl.com/injuries/ is current-week only.
suggestions.recommendation: Decide later: cheap and reversible, start the weekly snapshot when the legal position (S02) permits republication.

suggestions.title: Adopt a disclosed injury-to-points conversion (published as a band, not a point)
suggestions.context: No measured conversion exists from 'player out' to points; it needs snap counts and per-player value, neither published. This site publishes the injury sensitivity as a band, not a point estimate.
options: Adopt a disclosed multiplier band (current state: 0.25/0.50/1.00 pts per OUT/Doubtful/Questionable)
Wait for official snap counts
Buy a player-value model
suggestions.evidence: Injury band published beside each originated line (F-02/F-05).
suggestions.cost: Low if adopting a disclosed assumption; high if buying a model.
suggestions.risk: Medium: presenting an assumed conversion as measured would misstate precision.
suggestions.recommendation: Decide later: keep the band and label it a disclosed assumption; never present it as official.

suggestions.title: Obtain an archived same-game-parlay (SGP) price for correlated prop combos
suggestions.context: QB passing yards and WR1 receiving yards co-occur more than independence predicts (measured dependence), but books reprice correlated legs. No archived SGP price exists here, so the dependence is a measured fact, not a claimed edge, and C8 is blank.
options: Buy archived SGP prices
Keep prop combos off the leaderboard until a price exists
Trade cross-game legs only (independence supported near-zero)
suggestions.evidence: Correlation C5 (QB pass / WR1 rec) measured from available data; C8 (SGP price) blank.
suggestions.risk: High: pricing a prop combo as independent when legs are dependent misprices the combo.
suggestions.recommendation: Decide now: keep prop combos off the leaderboard until an archived SGP price exists; cross-game parlays may use independence (measured near-zero dependence).

suggestions.title: Adopt a written skill definition before any reward is paid
suggestions.context: A loose definition pays for luck. The proposed definition: skilful only if it survives FDR across every test including placebos, has a week-clustered CI above zero, and earns less than 50% of profit in any single season. The owner must confirm this is strict enough.
options: Adopt the proposed skill definition
Adopt a stricter or looser definition
Pay no rewards (research points only)
suggestions.evidence: 0 strategies qualify this snapshot; both pre-registered placebos fail.
suggestions.risk: High: a loose definition rewards luck, not skill.
suggestions.recommendation: Decide now: adopt the proposed definition and keep rewards as research points until S02 is settled.

suggestions.title: Review the third-party archive licence before redistributing derived values
suggestions.context: The archive is a public GitHub repo but its licence terms were not reviewed line by line. Whether redistribution of derived values or the raw file is permitted is unknown.
options: Review the archive licence (LICENSE file) and record terms
Avoid redistributing raw archive data; publish only derived values with citation
Stop using the archive
suggestions.evidence: Archive used and labelled as third-party; licence not reviewed.
suggestions.risk: Medium: redistribution could breach licence terms.
suggestions.recommendation: Decide later: review LICENSE, record terms on the source register, publish only cited derived values in the meantime.

suggestions.title: Establish whether an official 2026 player-level box-score feed exists
suggestions.context: nfl.com/stats/ presents player statistics client-side; no official per-game log or automated download endpoint was established. This blocks any 2026 player-prop model.
options: Contact NFL stats for a licensed feed
Remain prop-free until a feed exists
Use third-party player logs and label them third-party
suggestions.evidence: nfl.com/stats/ is client-rendered; no official download feed established.
suggestions.recommendation: Decide later: keep prop strategies off the leaderboard until an official or clearly-labelled third-party player feed exists.

suggestions.title: Choose one canonical NFL dashboard; consolidate or archive the rest
suggestions.context: Sixteen NFL namespaces exist in this repository with heavy overlap (four publish own lines, five publish questions, six publish suggestions). A reader cannot tell which is current.
options: Keep this namespace canonical and archive the others
Merge into one canonical namespace
Leave all sixteen published
suggestions.evidence: COORDINATION.md namespaces; root index lists 16 NFL workspaces.
suggestions.recommendation: Decide later: designate one canonical dashboard and link the others as historical.
